title: CollaborationSourceLink
description: One persisted derivation edge from a Context or an artifact to one exact source. Owner and source share a namespace. For an artifact owner, owner_version is that artifact's artifact_version and the set of links equals the artifact's source_refs.

owner_kind.description: context owners are keyed by context_id; artifact owners by artifact_id.

owner_version.description: artifact_version for an artifact owner; null for a context owner.
